methodology.rationale: At n=47, LLM-driven clustering produces tighter, more interpretable themes than ML-based approaches (HDBSCAN/KMeans on embeddings). Trade-off: less reproducible without an explicit cluster prompt.
methodology.scoring: composite_score = severity_weighted_sum + (unique_source_ids × unique_source_types). Severity weights: high=3, medium=2, low=1.
methodology.limitations: JD-derived pains over-index in severity (workflow descriptions read as blocking). Nortridge over-indexed in raw count (8 of 40 source rows). Discount Nortridge-only clusters when interpreting.
